objective: Kill 10 Marsh Inkspewers, 10 Marsh Flesheaters, and 10 Marsh Oracles, then return to Katar in the Swamp of Sorrows.

description: It pleases me to see your hatred for the fish men grows with mine.
Find more of their kind along the beach, and when you've had your fill of combat, return to me. We shall speak then of a reward for your diligence.
progress: Not until the sea and all her children are silenced will I be pleased... especially those disgusting fish men.
completion: Well done, <class>. I call for more of their blood. Let all the fish men perish.
